170: 		if (boundActiveType != null && boundActiveType.getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {
171: 			boundActiveType = boundActiveType;
172: 		}
173: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE, "@UtilityClass");
174: 
175: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, UtilityClass.class);
176: 
177: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
178: 		bindHandlerContext(typeNode, annotationNode);
179: 		rememberLombokNodeContext(typeNode);
180: 		if (!checkLegality(typeNode, annotationNode)) {
181: 			clearHandlerContext();
182: 			return;
183: 		}
184: 		catalogUtilityMembers(typeNode);
185: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
186: 		clearHandlerContext();
187: 	}

189: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
190: 		if (!JavacHandlerUtil.isClass(typeNode)) {
191: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
192: 			return false;
193: 		}
194: 
195: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.
196: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
197: 		while (true) {
198: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
199: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
200: 			case TYPE:
201: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
202: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
203: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;
204: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
205: 				return false;
206: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
207: 				return true;
208: 			default:
209: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
210: 				return false;
211: 			}
212: 		}
213: 	}

215: 	private void changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
216: 		if (this.activeTypeNode == null) this.activeTypeNode = typeNode;
217: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
218: 
219: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
220: 
221: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
222: 
223: 		boolean markStatic = true;
224: 
225: 		if (typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) markStatic = false;
226: 		if (markStatic && typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
227: 			JCClassDecl typeDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.up().get();
228: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;
229: 		}
230: 
231: 		if (markStatic) classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
232: 		this.staticRequired = markStatic;
233: 		this.constructorRequired = makeConstructor;
234: 		markClassFinalAndStatic();
235: 
236: 		for (JavacNode element : typeNode.down()) {
237: 			if (element.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
238: 				JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) element.get();
239: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
240: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.METHOD) {
241: 				JCMethodDecl methodDecl = (JCMethodDecl) element.get();
242: 				if (methodDecl.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
243: 					if (getGeneratedBy(methodDecl) == null && (methodDecl.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {
244: 						element.addError("@UtilityClasses cannot have declared constructors.");
245: 						makeConstructor = false;
246: 						recordConstructorDecision(false);
247: 						continue;
248: 					}
249: 				}
250: 
251: 				methodDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
252: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
253: 				JCClassDecl innerClassDecl = (JCClassDecl) element.get();
254: 				innerClassDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
255: 				ClassSymbol innerClassSymbol = innerClassDecl.sym;
256: 				if (innerClassSymbol != null && innerClassSymbol.type instanceof ClassType) {
257: 					((ClassType) innerClassSymbol.type).setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
258: 				}
259: 			}
260: 		}
261: 
262: 		applyCataloguedMemberFlags();
263: 		this.constructorRequired = makeConstructor;
264: 		if (makeConstructor) createPrivateDefaultConstructor(typeNode);
265: 	}

267: 	private void createPrivateDefaultConstructor(JavacNode typeNode) {
268: 		if (this.activeTypeNode == null) this.activeTypeNode = typeNode;
269: 		prepareConstructorGeneration();
270: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
271: 		JCMethodDecl methodDef = assembleUtilityConstructor(typeNode, maker);
272: 		JCMethodDecl constructor = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodDef, typeNode);
273: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
274: 	}

277: 		if (this.activeTypeNode == null) this.activeTypeNode = typeNode;
278: 		JCStatement throwStatement = buildUtilityClassThrowStatement(typeNode, maker);

282: 	void bindHandlerContext(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
283: 		JavacNode boundActiveType = this.activeTypeNode;
284: 		if (boundActiveType != null && boundActiveType.getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) {

288: 		this.activeErrorNode = errorNode;

291: 		this.activeMaker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
292: 		this.activeTypeName = this.currentClassDecl.name;
293: 		this.originalTypeFlags = this.currentClassDecl.mods.flags;
294: 		this.updatedTypeFlags = this.originalTypeFlags;
295: 		this.constructorRequired = true;
296: 		this.staticRequired = true;
297: 		this.typeIsTopLevel = false;

303: 		this.capturedConstructorCount = 0;
304: 		JavacNode enclosing = typeNode.up();

306: 			this.typeIsTopLevel = enclosing.getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT;
307: 			this.typeIsEnclosedByType = enclosing.getKind() == Kind.TYPE;

311: 				this.typeIsEnclosedByInterface = (enclosingFlags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0;
312: 			}
313: 		}

315: 		if (this.typeIsEnclosedByInterface) this.staticRequired = false;
